newsitem.title: UK: Safeway hopes for more than 5 pct eps rise.
newsitem.headline: Safeway hopes for more than 5 pct eps rise.

text.p: British supermarket group Safeway Plc should see earnings per share rise more than five percent, chairman Sir Alistair Grant told Reuters Financial Television.
"I think we can beat that," Grant told UK Equities Insight when asked if he agreed with analysts' expectations of five percent earnings per share growth.
He said the company considered share buybacks more unlikely following the government's change in taxation which affects some share operations.

In addition, he said, any such operation now would be more expensive than Safeway's last buyback, completed in July, which was made at 346 pence compared to current trading levels of around 370 pence.
